hypothesis: A fixed five-human value input can waste slots on redundant risks to the same executable actions. Selecting complementary witnesses over the original80-action risk matrix improves complete navigation beyond nearest/TTC/scalar-risk selection at the identical input budget.
module: Runtime wrapper of _build_joint_state_34 only: choose up to5 currently observable human states, then call the original builder. Same field meanings and34-vector size, frozen encoder/GRU/head. Current and all hypothetical successor tokens use the same selection rule. All-human reward/safety/MPPI unchanged.
risk: For each original native raw action, compute smoothing-consistent velocity (current robot velocity as the previous velocity; original no-prior exception at first current token), then exact swept relative constant-velocity closest approach and circle TTC on [0,4s]. Weight=0.5*min(1,0.25/TTC) for finite TTC +0.5*clip((0.2-minimum_clearance)/0.2,0,1). Infinite TTC contributes zero. No human goal or actual future.
ttc: Rank humans by earliest circle TTC for the current robot velocity, then distance; choose5. No-collision TTC infinity falls back to nearest distance. Ordinary deployment baseline, not a full perceived-risk project reproduction.
scalar: Rank humans by mean risk weight across all80 executable actions, choose5. Same matrix/information as cover; the first greedy cover choice equals this unary-risk choice.
cover: Greedy cardinality5 maximization of F(S)=mean_a max_{i in S} weight[a,i], F(empty)=0. Ties use nearest distance then original index. Standard monotone facility/witness coverage, not claimed as a newly invented optimizer.
budget: No fitting, training, extra input channels or extra actions. Every new arm computes all three selections for matching work; only the selected5 differ. All use identical frozen fixed8 MPPI fallback. N<=5 returns original nearest input exactly.
controls: Synthetic redundant-risk positive control; exact nearest builder parity at every call; exact N<=5 parity; risk first-command smoothing agreement; six complete case121 native episodes and one exact duplicate. Cover must differ from scalar in at least1% of N>5 token queries and at least2 scenes, otherwise KILL inactive reference before full cohort.

development.scope: Known development cases, not confirmation. Exact nominal/fixed8 results reused only after nearest builder parity; current timing not claimed identical.

go: No success/contact/collision regression against ANY control; at least2 additional successes versus EVERY control OR5% faster paired-both-success time versus EVERY control; selected human sets differ and actual decisions change; mean decision below250ms. Fresh confirmation only after all conditions and a credible incremental-capability prior review. Paper PASS additionally requires case-bootstrap confirmation and independent mechanism, not just a standard selector working.
kill: Inactive complementary selection, correct activation but failed task/safety/compute gate, or ordinary scalar/TTC selection absorbs benefit. No kernel/horizon/K sweeps, no retraining rescue or other change after valid activation.
scope: Changing which5 legal humans are encoded changes distribution relative to nearest-trained weights, not feature semantics. This reference tests the frozen-policy adaptation only; negative outcome does not prove no trained selector could work. Geometric coverage is not a certificate of value-ranking accuracy or future safety. Actual additional capability/novelty UNVERIFIED.
common: Native50s/dt0.25/original80, all legal humans available to the same safety/planner, original reward, margin0.2/risk0.8/smoothing0.3, T24legal-prefix, same nominal weight. No4090, no new Parent, no old Bayes/recovery/prediction experiment.
